title: 33 · small_sage · The Small Sage
lines: So many came to Shiva's wedding that the earth tilted.
One very small man was sent to fix it.
Every god. Every sage. Every ghost and goblin.
All of them climbed to the Himalaya on the same day.
The north sank. The south rose into the air.
The whole world was about to tip over.
past the kings and the gods,
at the shortest sage in the last row.
You will see it from there. I promise.
"You will see it from there. I promise."
So the little sage walked away from the greatest day in history,
One small man, weighing as much as all the gods together.
That night, the whole wedding appeared in the sky above him.
Your place may be far from the party. Hold it. The world is leaning on you. That is sadhana.
